Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building scalable REST APIs, intelligent ERP systems, and modern React frontends. Experienced with RBAC, modular backend architectures, and Docker-based deployments. Motivated by complex, evolving technical environments and driven to ship robust, well-structured software.

**Professional Experience**

**Full Stack Software Developer,** ***Hippomed AI*** 05/2025 – 10/2025

*Tunis, Tunisia · AI-powered healthcare ERP startup*

**Full Stack Developer Intern,** ***Wowsoft*** 07/2024 – 08/2024

*Tataouine, Tunisia*

- Built responsive, production-ready frontends with Next. js and Type Script, integrating REST APIs with SSR for performant, scalable interfaces.
- Maintained code quality and documentation standards throughout the stack; optimised component structure and data-fetching patterns across devices.

**Projects**

**Task Vortex** *, Real-time collaborative project management tool* 08/2025 – 10/2025

- Architected a scalable Nest JS backend with JWT authentication, RBAC, Redis caching (40% latency reduction), and Bull MQ for background job processing.

- Built a responsive React + Type Script frontend with drag-and-drop task boards, Tan Stack Query for server state, and Docker/Nginx for containerised deployment.
- Tech: React, Type Script, Nest JS, Zod, Web Sockets, Bull MQ, Redis, Mongo DB, Docker, Nginx, JWT

**Skilline** *, Gamified learning platform with AI integration* 03/2025 – 04/2025

- Integrated Gemini API for AI-powered content suggestions, building user-facing intelligent features — direct experience with LLM/AI service integration.
- Built full-stack React + Type Script application with flashcard flows, leaderboards, and Framer Motion animations; maintained consistent design system with Shad CN UI.
- Tech: React, Next. js, Type Script, Tailwind CSS, Shad CN UI, Express, Gemini API, Framer Motion

**Prestige Deco** *, Full-stack e-commerce application* 03/2025 – 04/2025

- Delivered a performance-optimised full-stack app with Postgre SQL/Mongo DB data models, REST API backend, and responsive Next. js frontend.
- Tech: Next. js, Type Script, Express, Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Mongoose, Tailwind CSS, Shad CN UI

**Technical Skills**

**Backend & amp; APIs:** Python (Fast API, Django, Flask, Pydantic), Node. js (Nest JS, Express), Spring Boot, REST API design, Graph QL, Web Sockets, SQLAlchemy, Django ORM, Drizzle ORM

**Databases:** Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, My SQL, Redis — schema design, query optimisation, RBAC, data modelling

**Frontend:** React. js, Next. js, Angular, Type Script, Java Script ES 6+, HTML 5, CSS 3, Tailwind CSS, Shad CN UI, Redux Toolkit, Tan Stack Query, Rx JS

**AI & amp; Intelligent Systems:** Gemini API, LLM integration, AI-assisted development (Git Hub Copilot), semantic workflow concepts

**Dev Ops & amp; Tools:** Docker, Nginx, Git/Git Hub, CI/CD pipelines, Postman, Bull MQ, Jira

**Mobile:** React Native, Ionic (i OS & amp; Android)

*Ariana, Tunisia · MERN, MEAN, Spring Boot, Flask — full-stack apps, RESTful APIs, authentication, database integration*
